On the way up Cerro Bonete, the urge to turn around and look back grows stronger. The tents at Plaza de Mulas recede below, the valley opens wider and wider, and Aconcagua dominates the view. There are rocks and loose scree underfoot and exposed slopes all around. This hike is a chance to experience the high Andes beyond the campsite and see the route ahead from another perspective.

Cerro Bonete stands near the Plaza de Mulas base camp in the Aconcagua area. Rising to approximately 5,000 meters, the peak is used for acclimatization hikes. A day in the mountains here helps prepare for further altitude gains while offering its own memorable views of the Andes.

On the Ada Tours expedition, the Cerro Bonete ascent is planned as a day trip returning to base camp the same day. The itinerary allows around six hours for the ascent, although the actual pace depends on the guide, the weather, and the condition of the group. Afterwards, there is time to rest and prepare for the high-altitude camps. Participants need good physical fitness and equipment suited to cold, windy conditions at high elevation.

On Bariloche's Circuito Chico route, the ascent of Cerro Campanario is combined with stops at Lake Nahuel Huapi and Playa Bonita. Among the bodies of water visible from the summit is Laguna El Trébol. This is a stop for sweeping views across the lake district, rather than a separate long-distance mountain trek.

Cerro Castillo is located in Chile's southern Aysén Region, near the Ibáñez River valley and the Carretera Austral. The name encompasses a mountain massif, a national park, and the roadside village of Villa Cerro Castillo. This page focuses on the area as a stop on a road trip.

Dark rocky peaks rise above forested slopes. From the road, travelers can take in mountain views and the broad valley. The village serves as a trailhead for hikes, while for those traveling by car the area connects Balmaceda and Coyhaique with General Carrera Lake and Puerto Río Tranquilo.

A walk in the national park and a drive through the Cerro Castillo area call for different itineraries. When choosing a tour, check whether it includes only the drive or a separate guided hike.
